build_activation_module: build a PyTorch activation module from a string name like relu, swish, or h_swish
make_divisible_channels: make a channel count divisible by a given divisor for MobileNet-style width scaling
drop_connect_tensor: apply drop connect regularization to a BCWH tensor with a given dropout probability
copy_batch_norm_state: copy batch norm weight, bias, running mean, and running var from source to target layer
get_same_padding_for_kernel: compute same padding value for an odd kernel size used in convolutional layers
